descriptions.text: Enchanted Pauper’s Ring of the Steadfast Emberus. Ah, Emberus. Wholly sane, reasonable Emberus. I’m sure any jewelry that bears his name will be a perfectly fine, normal piece of magical gear. When working properly, this ring will remove most health-seeping and disease-based debuff effects. Has a variable numbing effect on various other debuff types. This will not remove the debuff itself. Too many active debuffs of any kind may temporarily mute or overheat this ring. Warning: This ring may only be worn by a worshipper of Emberus. This will turn into a cursed item if worn by a non-worshipper. …

recap.text: Mantaurs bang on the door while Carl has his slug condition, so he takes a 990,000-gold interest-free loan from the Temple of Emberus. Pater Coal, the cleric, asks him to trade in his strength ring, the first ring he got in the dungeon. While Carl owes the debt, he may not renounce his religion. The goat-legged satyr jeweller dunks the ring in bubbling lava, and it comes out cool, looking the same, still labelled a strength ring.

Carl's Emberus ring flashes and warms as a burning pang rips across his midsection, and the health menu names it Soul Poisoning, only partly blocked by the Pauper's ring. He wakes on his back with a burning finger, the ring overloaded, and a slugpox boil rising on his back. Then the ring catches up and contains the slugpox, though worms still flow from his nose.

Carl pulls the Emberus ring off his finger and puts it in his inventory, though the ring keeps his slugpox under control and he kept the slugpox active on purpose. Mordecai's cure potion sits forgotten on the crafting table. Carl tells the roaring Emberus he was one of two who killed the god's son, then clicks Yes when the System asks if he is sure. The tattoos on his hands burst into flame.

beats.headline: A loan from the temple
beats.text: Mantaurs bang on the door, and Carl has his slug condition. Pater Coal, the cleric, does not charge interest to martyrs, but Carl must trade in a piece of jewellery he has worn a long time. He hands over his strength ring, the first ring he got in the dungeon, and takes an interest-free loan of 990,000 gold from the Temple of Emberus; while he owes it, he may not renounce his religion. The goat-legged satyr jeweller, twin tattoos on his hands like Carl's, dunks it in bubbling lava. It comes out cool, looking the same, still labelled a strength ring.
beats.gist: Carl swaps his first dungeon ring for a 990,000-gold Emberus temple loan; the lava dunk changes nothing visible.

beats.headline: Soul Poisoning
beats.text: A burning pang rips across Carl's midsection out of nowhere, and his Emberus ring flashes and grows warm. He keeps the pain out of his voice and moves to his health menu. His first thought is the tattoo on his chest, but the notification says otherwise: Soul Poisoning, its effects partially blocked by his Pauper's ring of the Steadfast Emberus, and worsening, a very minor case of stop-carrying-stored-souls-on-your-back.
beats.gist: Carl's Emberus ring flashes warm as a burning pang hits; his health menu names Soul Poisoning.

beats.headline: Overloaded
beats.text: Carl comes to on his back with a list of debuffs, Shit-Faced and Stiff Legs among them, and his finger burns. It is the Emberus ring, overloaded. He still has slugpox, because he never had Imani cure it, and with the ring not working a big boil rises on his back. He wonders what level the slugs are at now.
beats.gist: Carl wakes among his debuffs, his finger burning from the overloaded Emberus ring, a boil rising.

beats.headline: Catching up
beats.text: Carl's legs still will not bend, his fingers still end in suction cups, and screaming worms still flow out of his nose, but the Emberus ring seems to catch up at last: some of the other debuffs are contained, the slugpox among them. He sits up in the empty room beside the sluggalo.
beats.gist: Carl's debuffs mostly persist, but the Emberus ring catches up and contains some, including the slugpox.

beats.headline: Slugpox on purpose
beats.text: Donut calls for Imani: Carl's stupid slugpox is back. He kept it active on purpose, because the Emberus ring keeps it under control and he wanted it ready, arguing that the birth of Bigs on the previous floor saved him. Pretty much everyone thought it a terrible idea. Mordecai made a potion to cure it, and it is still sitting on the crafting table with the backpack. They forgot to bring it.
beats.gist: Donut calls Imani because Carl kept his slugpox active on purpose, and the cure was left behind.

beats.headline: Off the finger
beats.text: Emberus is roaring for the one who killed his son. Carl lies that he is coming, and that he was only one of two. Then he pulls the Emberus ring off his finger, puts it in his inventory, goes into his menus and makes a selection. The System asks whether he is sure. He clicks Yes: he no longer worships Emberus, and a smite is coming. The tattoos on the backs of his hands burst into flame, and he waves away a notification about the ring. The other one to kill the god's son, he says, was him.
beats.gist: Carl pulls off the Emberus ring, renounces the god, and lies to him while his tattoos burn.
